scenes.narration: Disney makes the biggest movies on Earth. So why aren't movies its money machine?
In fiscal 2025, Disney's parks, cruises and products division made a record 10 billion dollars in operating income.
That's about 57 percent of all the operating income Disney's businesses brought in.
Once you're through the gates, Disney earns on tickets, hotels, food and merch, all in one trip.
The movies create the characters. The parks turn them into money.
